context: Decide which side is right per case. The shipped behaviour looks intentional and better, so the expected outcome is a doc correction rather than a code change - but state that explicitly per case rather than assuming. description:
docs/operations/results-explorer-qa.md S6.5 specifies: empty `?ids=` produces a friendly error, and a single id either redirects to ResultDetail or shows a 'need 2+' message. Neither matches the code: empty `?ids=` shows the builder (Compare.tsx:176-181) and a single id resolves and pins the builder (Compare.tsx:184+).

This matters beyond tidiness: the remediation sequence treats this document as a contract, and rx-ux-19's parity gate is written against it. A drifted contract cannot gate anything.

anti_patterns.dont: change Compare's behaviour to match the stale doc
anti_patterns.instead: correct the doc, or raise a separate item if the code is genuinely wrong
anti_patterns.why: the single-ID builder pin is a live contract with e2e coverage

anti_patterns.dont: rewrite S6.5 without checking each of its four cases against the code
anti_patterns.instead: adjudicate case by case with a file:line citation
anti_patterns.why: this item exists because the doc drifted once already

preserves.behavior: /results/compare?ids=<one> pins that run and opens the builder (Compare.tsx:184+); ?ids=<a,b> renders a comparison. Both are live contracts (ResultDetail.tsx:266, e2e/routes/compare.spec.ts:58, compare-entrypoints.spec.ts:76).
Compare's builder entry behaviour, unless a case is explicitly judged a code defect
Compare's recovery rule that a multi-selection URL stays multi after a one-result recovery, so it does not collapse into the single-result builder (Compare.tsx:331-350).

verifications.description: Every S6.5 case cites the code path implementing it
verifications.expected: each case names the Compare.tsx behaviour it expects

verifications.description: No source changed under this documentation item

work_units.evidence: All four cases adjudicated against Compare.tsx:176-315 and 339-348, with unit/E2E coverage confirming builder, error, and partial-recovery behavior.
work_units.summary: Adjudicate all four S6.5 cases against Compare.tsx with citations

work_units.evidence: S6.5 now states the shipped expectation for each case and cites the implementing Compare.tsx ranges.
work_units.summary: Correct the doc for cases where shipped behaviour is right

work_units.evidence: No code case was judged defective; no separate tracker item is needed.
